title: Exact Results for the Symmetric Dyson Exclusion Process
summary: The symmetric Dyson exclusion process (SDEP) is an exclusion process on the lattice with a long-range logarithmic Coulomb-type interaction. It appears in several equivalent forms: as symmetric random walkers conditioned, in the Doob-transform sense, not to collide; as the maximal-activity limit of a conditioned SSEP; and as a ground-state transform of the spin- 1/2 XX chain. In this work, we exploit this latter representation to obtain exact evolution formulas from deterministic initial configurations. The resulting determinantal kernel is expressed through a finite interpolation expression…
